checks.note: The proposition swaps "allowing them to burn" for "burning", which implies actual consumption. The contract treats permitted allowance as the test. The contract also sets a valuation basis (API prices) and says interpretation does not decide the result, so blaming the accounting basis for the lack of a score is unsupported. The real gap is the lack of representative July user data. The citations are correct.
